questions.markdown:
Steam is generated in a boiler at a pressure of 10 bar. The steam leaving the boiler initially has a specific enthalpy of 2100 kJ/kg. It is then passed through a superheater, where it is further heated at the same pressure until its enthalpy reaches 2700 kJ/kg.

i) Determine the initial quality of the steam leaving the boiler and the quality after partial superheating.
ii) Alternatively, if the steam needs to be further heated in the superheater to become superheated by 10°C, calculate the additional heat required per kilogram of steam from the boiler exit.

Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Remember"

A steam boiler produces 6000kg of steam per hour at a pressure of 0.56 MPa and at a temperature of 230ºC. The feed water temperature is 25ºC. The mass of fuel consumption is 20 Kg/min., having a calorific value of 24MJ/kg. Assess the improvement in boiler efficiency if the following accessories are used.

i) Economizer will increase the feed water temperature to 63ºC and reduce coal consumption by 10%.
ii) Air Preheater which will reduce coal consumption by 22%.

Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Remember"

Compare the functions of blow-off cock and fusible plug.

A mechanical drive system in a mining plant uses a flat belt drive to transmit power between two parallel shafts rotating in opposite directions. The driver pulley has a diameter of 300 mm while the driven pulley on the output shaft runs at 250 rpm. The centre distance between the two pulleys is 800 mm. The initial belt tension is 1500 N, and the coefficient of friction between the belt and pulley surface is 0.28.
Determine the following:
i) The tensions in the tight side and slack side of the belt.
ii) The power transmitted by the belt.
iii) The length of the belt required for this belt drive.Assume the system provides a speed reduction ratio of 3:2.

Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Remember"

A compound gear train consists of six gears - A, B, C, D, E, and F. Gear A is the driver, and gear F is the driven gear, having 80 teeth and 18 teeth, respectively. Gear A meshes with gear B, and gears B and C are mounted on the same shaft. Gear C, which has 60 teeth, meshes with gear D. Gears D and E are mounted on another common shaft, and gear E finally meshes with gear F. The overall velocity ratio from gear A to gear F is 64. It is also given that the velocity ratio between A and B is equal to the velocity ratio between C and D, and equal to the velocity ratio between E and F.
Determine:
i) The number of teeth on gears B, D, and E.
ii) The centre distance between the driver and driven shafts, if the circular pitch of all gears is 2.5π mm.

Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Remember"
